title: The divergence spread

members.role: the line that ran away draws on its own word and lands with its end tag
the line that stayed flat draws on its word (a peer that moves with it draws beside it) and lands with its end tag
the gap between the two lines bleeds full of ink left to right on the word that names what the gap means

does: Two series draw one after the other, each on its own word and each landing with its end tag, then the region between them bleeds full of ink - the gap itself becomes the thing on the page.

use_when.act: SPANS - two once-together series now apart (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN R27)
use_when.shape: two series on one scale and one unit, sharing a start
use_when.use: a sentence that names both lines and then what the distance between them means ('Chipmakers doubling while their customers sit flat ... is textbook profit-taking')
use_when.dont: the gap is not the claim; two units or two scales (E79 panels); a page where the two lines are a derived chart state (the spread waits while a derived state stands - H row 10)

source: P71 T36 (harvest v2 R27; D40 04:30-04:50 read 2026-09-25: two lines, their end pills, the gap filled - no bracket; BOOM 08:35 the wedge fill); proved as a private test-bed beat by projects/_proofs/p71-recipes/proof_t36.py on Steel and Paper H row 10's sentence ('Chipmakers doubling ... textbook profit-taking', take 94.08 s) on ev-divergence-v1 as its own page - no approved cut carries it
